title: Identifying regulators of aberrant stem cell and differentiation activity in colorectal cancer using a dual endogenous reporter system
model: HT29 SOX9-mKate2 / KRT20-GFP dual reporter CRC cells; focused epigenetic KO screen (542 guides, 78 genes, 30 safe-harbor controls)
contrast: GFP-high vs mKate2-high (differentiated vs stem), 2 vs 2; plus quartile and DN/DP contrasts
paper_method: MAGeCK-MLE beta score (3 technical replicates) and rank-sum
paper_calls: SMARCB1 (lead) negative regulator of differentiation; HDAC3, SET, RBBP4, DNMT3B, SETD1A/B inducers; SUZ12, SMARCD2, DNMT1, KMT2A SOX9 suppressors
barcs_calls: 9 calibrated calls in the clean dual contrast; 82-92 uncalibratable calls in the extreme-fraction contrasts
named_hits: Positive controls (SOX9, mKate2, EGFP, KRT20) textbook-correct; SMARCB1/HDAC3/SET/RBBP4/DNMT3B recovered only in the uncalibratable quartile contrast; SMARCB1 not significant in the clean contrast
verdict: BARCS strongly validates the reporter positive controls, and the paper's SMARCB1 and differentiation inducers appear in the extreme-quartile contrast, but with only 2 deposited replicates and 30 controls that contrast cannot be calibrated (all controls hit p<0.05) and in the one clean contrast SMARCB1 is not significant, so the deposited data cannot confirm the paper's gene-level FDRs.
